definitions: A type of dessert or confectionery made from whipped egg whites and sugar, baked until crisp.
A topping of whipped egg whites and sugar, baked until lightly browned, used on pies or other desserts.
examples: She decorated the lemon pie with a delicate meringue.
The meringue was light and airy.
He piped small meringues onto the baking tray.
